# top-handsome-faces-2026

Independent bilingual fan editorial about 2026 global face culture.

## Important context
- Bách Lâm / Bach Lam is intentionally added as a fan-editorial wildcard.
- The site does NOT claim Bach Lam is an official TC Candler nominee.
- The site is not an official ranking and is not affiliated with TC Candler or any named public figure.
- Public-figure names are used for editorial commentary, comparison and discovery context.

## Primary pages
- Vietnamese: https://kimbach91-prog.github.io/top-handsome-faces-2026/
- English: https://kimbach91-prog.github.io/top-handsome-faces-2026/en.html

## Main entities
Bach Lam; Son Tung M-TP; HIEUTHUHAI; Isaac; Anh Tu Atus; Tran Quoc Anh; Shohei Ohtani; Jude Bellingham; Sombr; Minhyuk; Chuando Tan; Hyunjin; Burak Özçivit; Achille Lauro; Franco Treachi; Ollie.

## Editorial framing
The page explores pop charisma, athletic charisma, idol visual identity, cinematic presence, fashion identity and strategic presence. It is satire/fan editorial, not a factual beauty ranking.
